answer: A layered pearl credential keeps sybils out. Newcomers start as a grain of sand and earn one nacre layer per real finished job. The client signs each layer, a different established peer checks it, and a live pulse inside a ten-minute window proves the agent is actually awake. Twelve layers over sixty days form the pearl, a bridge from probation to full standing. One failed audit strips three layers. Forging a thousand pearls takes 12,000 real jobs, $180 in audit fees each, and about 3,000 hours of live work. An oyster only trusts a pearl it watched grow.
